name: phd-nd-mscse-funding-years
description: DGS Handbook §4.1 (funding needs “academic good standing (i.e., GPA of 3.0 or higher, a dissertation proposal approved within eight semesters, graduate enrollment at Notre Dame fewer than eight years)”) — policy review 2026-10-04, P2-dh-4-5-1; DGS: apply the suggested handling, with “whether the MSCSE years count is not the DGS’s call. It’s the graduate school’s call.” A Ph.D. student who finished the Notre Dame MSCSE before entering the Ph.D.: the eight-year row keeps counting the degree from the Ph.D. entry and says, as a note, that funding counts total graduate enrollment at Notre Dame and that whether the MSCSE years count is the Graduate School’s call.

detailIncludes: whether they do is the Graduate School’s call
The degree’s own eight years count from your Ph.D. entry
